Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you
reported. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just give you the facts, but I'm the driver of the vehicle involved.
Q: Understood. Can you walk me through where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was in League City, on a multi-lane road heading toward the interchange. Traffic was moderate and I needed to
move one lane over because my exit was coming up.
Q: What did you do before changing lanes?
A: I checked my mirror and glanced over my shoulder. I saw a gap, so I signaled and started to move over.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle at any point before contact?
A: Not clearly. I felt a jolt on the driver's side and heard a loud scrape. By the time I looked, the other car was already
alongside me and then it pulled ahead.
Q: Did you or the other driver stop afterward?
A: Yes, we both pulled onto the shoulder. We exchanged information and stayed there until the police officer arrived.
Q: Were you injured?
A: Yes. My right shoulder hit the door frame and it's been sore and stiff since. I went to be checked out that same day
and I'm still having trouble lifting my arm above my head.
Q: Have you received any medical treatment since then?
A: I've had two follow-up visits and I'm scheduled for physical therapy. The doctor said it could take several weeks to
improve.
Q: Thank you. Is there anything you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I was trying to drive carefully and I'm hoping this gets resolved quickly so I can get back to normal.
Q: Thank you. This conculdes the statement.
</page>

"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.

address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
